title: How Much Exercise You Need
summary: WHO recommends adults get at least 150–300 minutes of moderate activity (or 75–150 minutes vigorous) per week, plus muscle-strengthening on 2 or more days. Any activity is better than none.
answer_guidance: Explain clearly and simply in the user's language; give steps or examples when the user asks how.
